player_prompt.intro:
Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ {player_id} iɣɾaɣ {colour} ({piece}) ɣ wuri n Othello.
Alɣuɾ-ik ikkaɣ ad ɛeddiɣ ɣef teɣɾatin n tɛɣla-k ɣ wakal dɣa n wuri.
Asɣiw-ik, ɛeddaɣ tɛɣɾat nɣɾaɣ maɣ ad teɛɛɾiɣ ɣef teɣɾatin n imɛɣɾan-k ɣ kulu tɛɣɾi (ɣ wakal, ɣ wadda, neɣ ɣ tɛɣɾi tɛɣɾɛɣt)-ɣɾaɣ n teɣɾat nɣɾaɣ dɣa n tɛɣɾat nɣɾaɣ nɣɾaɣ. Kulu teɣɾatin n imɛɣɾan-k nɣɾaɣ ad tɛddɣɾɣɣɣ ɣ tɛɣla-k.
Sɛɛɾ-ik tɛɣɾat-k ɣ wakal n '[row, col]'.
